* is - Date equals the specified date value
* is not - Date does not equal the specified date value
* greater than - Date is more recent than the specified date value
* less than - Date is older than the specified date value
* greater than or equal - Date is more recent or equal to the specified date value
* less than or equal - Date is older than or equal to the specified date value

* is - Number equals the specified numeric value
* is not - Number does not equal the specified numeric value
* greater than - Number is greater than the specified numeric value
* less than - Number is less than the specified numeric value
* greater than or equal - Number is greater than or equal to the specified numeric value
* less than or equal - Number is less than or equal to the specified numeric value

SearchFilterComparatorString.description:
* is - String equals the specified string value
* is not - String does not equal the specified string value
* starts with - String starts with the specified string value
* ends with - String ends with the specified string value
* contains - String contains the specified string value
